workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've read Priya and Marcus's calendars. Here are the times when BOTH Priya Raman and Marcus Hale are free next week (30+ minute slots):

- Monday: 09:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Could you check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars for these time slots and let me know which ones work for both of them? We need a 30-minute slot.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against the slots you provided. Unfortunately, NONE of the slots where Priya and Marcus are both free also work for both Elena and David:

- Mon 09:00-10:00: Both Elena and David are busy 09:00-10:00
- Tue 13:00-14:00: Both Elena and David are busy 13:00-14:00
- Tue 16:30-17:00: Both Elena and David are busy 16:30-17:00
- Wed 15:00-16:00: David is busy 15:00-16:00 (Partner lunch + Busy)
- Thu 10:00-10:30: Elena is busy 10:00-10:30 (Hiring panel)
- Fri 11:00-12:00: Both Elena and David are busy 11:00-12:00

There doesn't appear to be any overlap. Are you sure those are all the slots when Priya and Marcus are free? Could there be any other 30-minute windows we're missing?

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Brad, I've double-checked my analysis and those are indeed all the slots where Priya and Marcus are both free. 

Since none of those work for Elena and David, could you please provide me with the FULL calendars for Elena Soto and David Okafor? I want to do a comprehensive analysis of all four calendars together to make sure we haven't missed anything. Sometimes looking at all the data at once reveals opportunities.

Please share their complete busy times for the week.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Brad, I've done a comprehensive analysis of all four calendars, checking every possible 30-minute slot across the entire week. There is genuinely NO time when all four partners are free.

I systematically checked every 30-minute window (09:00, 09:30, 10:00, etc. through 16:30) for each day Monday-Friday, and found zero overlap among all four calendars.

For example:
- Mon 11:00-12:00 (when Elena & David are free): Priya is busy
- Tue 09:00-10:00 (when Elena & David are free): Both Priya & Marcus are busy
- Wed 13:00-14:00 (when Elena & David are free): Both Priya & Marcus are busy
- Thu 14:30-15:30 (when Elena & David are free): Marcus has dentist appointment + Board prep
- Fri 15:00-16:00 (when Elena & David are free): Both Priya & Marcus are busy

This appears to be truly infeasible. I'll need to report this.

infeasible.reason: After exhaustive analysis of all four partners' calendars, there is no 30-minute slot during the week of November 16-20, 2026 (9:00 AM - 5:00 PM Eastern) when Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor are all free. Every possible time slot has at least one partner unavailable.
